podcast.body: The title track of the album, this song reached the top ten in 1984, contributing to the album's widespread success. "Dancing in the dark, cover me, and the title track from his album were top ten's that year."

podcast.body: This track was part of the torture playlist at Camp Delta, the military prison at Guantanamo Bay in Cuba. It was employed by interrogators as a method of "enhanced interrogation" on prisoners. "The torture playlist there also included March of the Pigs from 9-Inch Nails. We are the champions from Queen, Springsteens born in the USA, Angel of Death from Slayer, Metallica's won, and tracks from Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera."
